description: The 2013 Ford Escape SE immediately stands out with its technology ecosystem, offering a user-friendly infotainment interface anchored by SiriusXM radio and an AM/FM Single-CD/MP3-capable audio system.  Tech-forward buyers prioritizing seamless smartphone integration and access to information on the go will appreciate this SUV's feature set. The system enables easy management of calls and music through steering wheel controls, while voice prompts and the radio data system add to the hands-free experience. For those commuting in Bastrop, TX or embarking on longer journeys, the presence of remote keyless entry and fully automatic headlights ensures convenience and safety, while the power liftgate and rear seat flexibility make loading gear or groceries hassle-free. The Escape SE is tailored for drivers who value connectivity, quick access to their apps, and practical tech to simplify every drive.  Performance in this Escape SE is enhanced by its EcoBoost 1.6L I4 GTDi DOHC Turbocharged VCT engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel drive. The turbocharged engine not only delivers responsive acceleration but also smartly balances power with fuel efficiency, achieving an EPA-estimated 23 city and 33 highway MPG. Electronic stability control and speed-sensing steering use digital feedback to adapt to varying road conditions, delivering a composed ride even in stop-and-go traffic. The trip computer and tachometer keep drivers informed about the vehicles real-time performance, ensuring a tech-savvy driving experience.  Safety is smartly integrated through multiple electronic systems. The Escape SE uses ABS brakes, traction control, electronic stability control, and brake assist to monitor and react to changing traction or emergency braking situations. Sensors throughout the SUV, including an occupant sensing airbag system and low tire pressure warning, provide continuous feedback to help prevent accidents. Dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, a knee airbag, and side curtain coverage are all managed by the SUVs onboard safety processors. The perimeter alarm and panic alarm offer added peace of mind, while the rear window wiper and defroster maintain visibility in challenging weather.  The Equipment Group 201A package brings together convenience and comfort features that directly benefit daily life. Highlights include a power liftgate for easy cargo access, split folding rear seats for flexible storage, and front fog lights for improved visibility. The SUVs cloth bucket seats and dual-zone air conditioning keep everyone comfortable, while the compass and outside temperature display give useful data at a glance.  Compared to rivals like the Honda CR-V EX and Toyota RAV4 XLE, the Escape SE distinguishes itself with its turbocharged EcoBoost engine and a suite of tech features that focus on real-world usability.  Does the Escape SE have wireless CarPlay or Android Auto? While it doesnt offer wireless smartphone mirroring, it does provide Bluetooth-enabled hands-free calling and audio streaming. What driver assistance technology is included? The SUV features electronic stability control, traction control, brake assist, and a comprehensive airbag suite.  To experience the technology and connectivity features of the Escape SE firsthand, visit Covert Chevrolet Bastrop at 702 State Hwy 71, Bastrop, TX 78602 or call (512) 308-3161.
